title: The 100 billion dollar race to build humanoid robots

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The "the" signifies a singular, unified vision for humanoid robots that aligns with global ethical and safety protocols.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: The "100" represents a clear, measurable goal—$100 billion invested in innovation, not vague idealism.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The "the" ensures universal standards, like ISO 10218-1, preventing fragmentation in robot design and safety.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: The "100" drives competition, pushing breakthroughs in AI, mobility, and human-robot interaction we can’t achieve alone.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The "100" is the future—specific, funded, and focused.
